geometryOracle.method: in-process rasterized-ink pixel diff, 4 samples/pen-width, same construction as tests/integration/expand-render-fidelity.test.js diffInk()
geometryOracle.note: onlyPre/onlyPost counts of raster cells present in exactly one of pre/post; ratioPct = (onlyPre+onlyPost)/pre * 100

realRenderFullCanvasDiff.method: actual browser canvas (port 8471), same crop window (before bbox +6px margin) shot before and after expandLayer(), pixels counted as different when any RGB channel differs by more than 8/255
realRenderFullCanvasDiff.caveat: diffPct is NOT law-specific: it is within ~2 points across all four laws tested (control laws included), so it measures a render-order/anti-aliasing floor common to any expand, not a per-law fidelity gap. bboxGrowth was NOT reliable in this harness (a script artifact unrelated to product geometry) and is omitted.
